description: This file defines string utility functions such as trimming, checking prefixes and suffixes, splitting strings, and parsing integers and booleans within the header_checker project.

methods.name: Trim
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from the input string_view.

methods.name: StartsWith
methods.description: Checks if the input string_view starts with the given prefix.

methods.name: EndsWith
methods.description: Checks if the input string_view ends with the given suffix.

methods.name: Split
methods.description: Splits the input string_view into a vector of string_views based on delimiter characters.

methods.name: ParseInt
methods.description: Attempts to parse an integer from the input string, returning an llvm::Optional<int>.

methods.name: ParseBool
methods.description: Parses a boolean value from the input string.

methods.name: IsGlobPattern
methods.description: Determines if the input string_view matches a glob pattern.
